title: Chrono / Cross Engine Random Skills from the Tool Map going off

posts.author: Gabiszon
posts.body:
Heya, lately i found myself with an frustrating cross/ chrono engine  ABS bug, Randomly when i Transfer the player / start the playtest, the game forcefully tries to play a random skill from the tool map (it specifically wants the player character to play them, even if there's no appropriate sprite), it started with the default ones (fireball, meteor etc) and when i delated them it tries to force play my custom tools.

I had the same thing happen! For some reason, it only started after I added the Yanfly Party System Plugin to my list of plugins. Anytime I started the game, the controls would lock and the character would spam tool events just like you and this other person are describing.
It was driving me up the wall, so I added the Yanfly Plugin to the demo project to verify it was the cause of the issue. But when I did, I couldn't reproduce the bug. So I spent a while comparing my project and the demo project, and aside from the plugins I was using, I noticed that the demo was set up so you don't start with a character in your party. Instead, you start with no characters, and then one gets added after you select the mode you're demoing.
So I tried changing my project to do exactly that, start with no actors in the System Menu,
Then add an actor with an event that starts when you launch the game (This is just the event I use, it autoruns on the map you start on),
And somehow that miraculously solved the issue for me. I should add that this was using RPG Maker MV, not MZ, and that I didn't delete any of the tool events on the tool map. I don't know what the actual cause of the glitch/incompatibility is, but after I did this, the tool spamming stopped. Hopefully, it does the same for you.

posts.author: Gabiszon
posts.body:
I will tell you guys, i tried both, and theyre both good advice but the bug prevailedHAHA It fixed itself different way:
I playtested extensively with the default toolmap today and what i noticed,
all the tools the game forced upon start/transfer player were the ones using tool_action_times: (1 action repeated x times))
for example it forced thunder II to play, i delate the command, then it forces to play meteor etc
And so, after i delated this command from every tool that had it, the bug somehow stopped. So far i everything is good, i cant make it spawn anymore. So far (who knows in the future though lol)
too bad i can't use tool_action_times
btw im happy i wasnt the only one with this ridiculous bug, i dimly remember it randomly happening on mv so it shouldnt be an issue with mz itself. my bet theres some compatibility issues that makes chrono/cross go highwire, i cant tell

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: I've seen it before using only MV and vanilla Chrono Engine with no Cross Engine. When I turned off YEP Party Manager it stopped so I'm inclined to think DsProssh is on the right track
